text: Most people think the Sahara is the world's largest desert, but they are completely wrong. By definition, a desert isn't about heat or sand. title: Your Brain Can Be Hacked By This Game 🧠 #shorts #psychology
description: Have you ever played a game so much you started seeing it in real life? That's the Tetris Effect. #shorts #mindfacts #science
text: If you stare at your screen too long, your brain does something terrifying called the Tetris Effect. In 1994, researchers noticed that people who played Tetris for hours began hallucinating falling blocks when closing their eyes, and even involuntarily rearranging cereal boxes in supermarkets. Your brain's visual cortex literally rewires itself to anticipate patterns. For more related content, make sure you subscribe for daily uploads.

description: Sharks survived 4 major mass extinctions and existed before trees ever grew on Earth. #shorts #evolution #facts

title: Why You Never See Yourself Blink 👁️ #shorts #science
description: Your brain spends hours every day secretly editing out darkness. Here is how. #shorts #neuroscience #facts
text: You blink over fifteen thousand times every day, yet you never notice a single second of darkness. Why? Your brain doesn't just ignore blinks; it actively deletes the memory of darkness. Every time your eyelids close, your visual cortex temporarily shuts down perception and stitches the before and after images together into seamless motion.
